milestones.title: M0 Setup
milestones.description: Repo, CI, local config, keys. Project runs and connects to the client.

milestones.title: M1 MVP Console Coach
milestones.description: Champ select detected, Claude recommends a pick from my pool and a loadout, printed in console.

milestones.title: M2 Auto Import
milestones.description: Runes, summoner spells and item set pushed into the client after lock-in.

milestones.title: M3 Personal Data
milestones.description: My own match history and champion stats fed into recommendations.

milestones.title: M4 Coach Loop
milestones.description: Post-game review and lesson tracking; the app teaches, not just prescribes.

milestones.title: M5 Desktop UI
milestones.description: Small always-on-top window instead of console output.

issues.title: Set up local environment and keys
issues.body:
- [ ] Create venv, `pip install -e ".[dev]"`
- [ ] Copy `.env.example` → `.env`, add `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`
- [ ] Copy `config.example.toml` → `config.toml`, set role and champion pool
- [ ] `pytest` passes locally

issues.title: Verify CI workflow runs green on GitHub
issues.body: First push should trigger `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (ruff + pytest). Fix anything Windows/Linux specific.

issues.title: Connect to League Client via lcu-driver
issues.body: Run `python -m rift_coach` with the client open and confirm the 'Connected' message. Check lockfile discovery works with a non-default install path.

issues.title: Record real champ-select sessions as fixtures
issues.body: Add a `--record` flag that dumps every `/lol-champ-select/v1/session` event to `tests/fixtures/recorded/`. **Strip all `gameName`/`tagLine`/`summonerId`/`puuid` fields before saving.** Use 2-3 recordings to replace the hand-made fixture.

issues.title: Validate champ-select parser against recorded sessions
issues.body: Cover: blind pick, draft with pick order swaps, trades, dodge, my pick being first vs last. Add tests per case.

issues.title: Tune pick prompt: pool-first, explain the why
issues.body: Iterate on `recommend_pick`. Goals: never outside pool (already enforced), reasoning mentions matchup + team comp, 2-4 sentences. Keep 5 example drafts and compare outputs between prompt versions.

issues.title: Tune loadout prompt and validate item names
issues.body: Reject/flag item names not in Data Dragon list. Consider passing only legendary items + boots + starters to cut tokens.

issues.title: Add cost and latency logging per Claude call
issues.body: Log `usage.input_tokens`/`output_tokens` and duration. Target: whole champ select < 10 s total wait, cost per game known.

issues.title: Debounce: recommend again only on meaningful draft change
issues.body: Currently re-asks when `DraftState.key()` changes during my turn. Check it doesn't spam calls on hover changes of allies; maybe ignore ally hovers.

issues.title: Verify stat shard IDs against /lol-perks/v1/perks
issues.body: `SHARD_IDS` in `runes.py` is hard-coded. Fetch perks from the client on startup and build the mapping dynamically, or at least assert the IDs exist.

issues.title: Test rune page import end-to-end
issues.body: Cases: page with same name exists, all slots full, no editable pages. Make sure we never delete a page that isn't ours without a config flag.

issues.title: Import summoner spells (respect Flash key preference)
issues.body: `set_summoner_spells` exists. Add config `flash_on = "D" | "F"` and order spells accordingly before PATCH.

issues.title: Write item set to the client
issues.body: Map item names → IDs from Data Dragon, PUT to `/lol-item-sets/v1/item-sets/{summonerId}/sets` with blocks: Start / Core / Situational. Only touch the set named `RiftCoach`.

issues.title: Fetch my match history via Riot API (match-v5)
issues.body: account-v1 (Riot ID → puuid), match-v5 ids + details. Cache to disk. Respect dev key rate limits.

issues.title: Per-champion personal stats and matchup history
issues.body: Win rate, games played, CS@10, deaths before 14 min, results vs specific enemy champions. Pass a compact summary into the pick prompt.

issues.title: Post-game review with Claude
issues.body: After a game: pull match + timeline, ask Claude for 3 concrete mistakes and 1 thing done well, focused on wave management, recall timing and deaths.

issues.title: Lesson tracker: focus of the week
issues.body: Store current focus (e.g. 'push before you move') in a local file. Show it in champ select and grade it in post-game review.

issues.title: Policy check before any sharing
issues.body: Personal use is fine. Before giving the app to anyone else: register at developer.riotgames.com, re-read LoL third-party policy (no names in ranked champ select, no in-game timers or real-time prescriptions).

issues.title: Desktop window (always on top) for recommendations
issues.body: Options: Tkinter/PySide6 small window, or local web page served by the app. Must not overlay the game itself.
